102.11: my days are like a fading shadow, I am withering up like grass.
102.12: But you, Yahweh, are enthroned for ever, each generation in turn remembers you.
102.13: Rise up, take pity on Zion! the time has come to have mercy on her, the moment has come;
102.14: for your servants love her very stones, are moved to pity by her dust.
102.15: Then will the nations revere the name of Yahweh, and all the kings of the earth your glory;
102.16: when Yahweh builds Zion anew, he will be seen in his glory;
102.17: he will turn to hear the prayer of the destitute, and will not treat their prayer with scorn.
102.18: This shall be put on record for a future generation, and a people yet to be born shall praise God:
102.19: Yahweh has leaned down from the heights of his sanctuary, has looked down from heaven to earth,
102.20: to listen to the sighing of the captive, and set free those condemned to death,
102.21: to proclaim the name of Yahweh in Zion, his praise in Jerusalem;
102.22: nations will gather together, and kingdoms to worship Yahweh.
102.23: In my journeying my strength has failed on the way;
102.24: let me know the short time I have left. Do not take me away before half my days are done, for your years run on from age to age.
102.25: Long ago you laid earth's foundations, the heavens are the work of your hands.
102.26: They pass away but you remain; they all wear out like a garment, like outworn clothes you change them;
102.27: but you never alter, and your years never end.
102.28: The children of those who serve you will dwell secure, and their descendants live on in your presence.

103.1: [Of David] Bless Yahweh, my soul, from the depths of my being, his holy name;
103.2: bless Yahweh, my soul, never forget all his acts of kindness.
103.3: He forgives all your offences, cures all your diseases,
103.4: he redeems your life from the abyss, crowns you with faithful love and tenderness;
103.5: he contents you with good things all your life, renews your youth like an eagle's.
103.6: Yahweh acts with uprightness, with justice to all who are oppressed;
103.7: he revealed to Moses his ways, his great deeds to the children of Israel.
103.8: Yahweh is tenderness and pity, slow to anger and rich in faithful love;
103.9: his indignation does not last for ever, nor his resentment remain for all time;
103.10: he does not treat us as our sins deserve, nor repay us as befits our offences.
103.11: As the height of heaven above earth, so strong is his faithful love for those who fear him.
103.12: As the distance of east from west, so far from us does he put our faults.
103.13: As tenderly as a father treats his children, so Yahweh treats those who fear him;
103.14: he knows of what we are made, he remembers that we are dust.
103.15: As for a human person -- his days are like grass, he blooms like the wild flowers;
103.16: as soon as the wind blows he is gone, never to be seen there again.
103.17: But Yahweh's faithful love for those who fear him is from eternity and for ever; and his saving justice to their children's children;
103.18: as long as they keep his covenant, and carefully obey his precepts.
103.19: Yahweh has fixed his throne in heaven, his sovereign power rules over all.
103.20: Bless Yahweh, all his angels, mighty warriors who fulfil his commands, attentive to the sound of his words.
103.21: Bless Yahweh, all his armies, servants who fulfil his wishes.
103.22: Bless Yahweh, all his works, in every place where he rules. Bless Yahweh, my soul.

104.1: Bless Yahweh, my soul, Yahweh, my God, how great you are! Clothed in majesty and splendour,
104.2: wearing the light as a robe! You stretch out the heavens like a tent,
104.3: build your palace on the waters above, making the clouds your chariot, gliding on the wings of the wind,
104.4: appointing the winds your messengers, flames of fire your servants.
104.5: You fixed the earth on its foundations, for ever and ever it shall not be shaken;
104.6: you covered it with the deep like a garment, the waters overtopping the mountains.
104.7: At your reproof the waters fled, at the voice of your thunder they sped away,
104.8: flowing over mountains, down valleys, to the place you had fixed for them;
104.9: you made a limit they were not to cross, they were not to return and cover the earth.
104.10: In the ravines you opened up springs, running down between the mountains,
104.11: supplying water for all the wild beasts; the wild asses quench their thirst,
104.12: on their banks the birds of the air make their nests, they sing among the leaves.
104.13: From your high halls you water the mountains, satisfying the earth with the fruit of your works:
104.14: for cattle you make the grass grow, and for people the plants they need, to bring forth food from the earth,
104.15: and wine to cheer people's hearts, oil to make their faces glow, food to make them sturdy of heart.
104.16: The trees of Yahweh drink their fill, the cedars of Lebanon which he sowed;
104.17: there the birds build their nests, on the highest branches the stork makes its home;
104.18: for the wild goats there are the mountains, in the crags the coneys find refuge.
104.19: He made the moon to mark the seasons, the sun knows when to set.
104.20: You bring on darkness, and night falls, when all the forest beasts roam around;
104.21: young lions roar for their prey, asking God for their food.
104.22: The sun rises and away they steal, back to their lairs to lie down,
104.23: and man goes out to work, to labour till evening falls.
104.24: How countless are your works, Yahweh, all of them made so wisely! The earth is full of your creatures.
104.25: Then there is the sea, with its vast expanses teeming with countless creatures, creatures both great and small;
104.26: there ships pass to and fro, and Leviathan whom you made to sport with.
104.27: They all depend upon you, to feed them when they need it.
104.28: You provide the food they gather, your open hand gives them their fill.
104.29: Turn away your face and they panic; take back their breath and they die and revert to dust.
104.30: Send out your breath and life begins; you renew the face of the earth.
104.31: Glory to Yahweh for ever! May Yahweh find joy in his creatures!
104.32: At his glance the earth trembles, at his touch the mountains pour forth smoke.
104.33: I shall sing to Yahweh all my life, make music for my God as long as I live.
104.34: May my musings be pleasing to him, for Yahweh gives me joy.
104.35: May sinners vanish from the earth, and the wicked exist no more! Bless Yahweh, my soul.

105.1: Alleluia! Give thanks to Yahweh, call on his name, proclaim his deeds to the peoples!
105.2: Sing to him, make music for him, recount all his wonders!
105.3: Glory in his holy name, let the hearts that seek Yahweh rejoice!
105.4: Seek Yahweh and his strength, tirelessly seek his presence!
105.5: Remember the marvels he has done, his wonders, the judgements he has spoken.
105.6: Stock of Abraham, his servant, children of Jacob whom he chose!
105.7: He is Yahweh our God, his judgements touch the whole world.
105.8: He remembers his covenant for ever, the promise he laid down for a thousand generations,
105.9: which he concluded with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.
105.10: He established it as a statute for Jacob, an everlasting covenant with Israel,
105.11: saying, 'To you I give a land, Canaan, your allotted birthright.'
105.12: When they were insignificant in numbers, a handful of strangers in the land,
105.13: wandering from country to country, from one kingdom and nation to another,
105.14: he allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he instructed kings,
105.15: 'Do not touch my anointed ones, to my prophets you may do no harm.'
105.16: He called down famine on the land, he took away their food supply;
105.17: he sent a man ahead of them, Joseph, sold as a slave.
105.18: So his feet were weighed down with shackles, his neck was put in irons.
105.19: In due time his prophecy was fulfilled, the word of Yahweh proved him true.
105.20: The king sent orders to release him, the ruler of nations set him free;
105.21: he put him in charge of his household, the ruler of all he possessed,
105.22: to instruct his princes as he saw fit, to teach his counsellors wisdom.
105.23: Then Israel migrated to Egypt, Jacob settled in the country of Ham.
105.24: He made his people increase in numbers, he gave them more strength than their enemies,
105.25: whose heart he turned to hate his own people, to double-cross his servants.
105.26: He sent his servant Moses, and Aaron, the man of his choice.
105.27: They worked there the wonders he commanded, marvels in the country of Ham.
105.28: Darkness he sent, and darkness fell, but that nation defied his orders.
105.29: He turned their rivers to blood, and killed all the fish in them.
105.30: Their country was overrun with frogs, even in the royal apartments;
105.31: at his word came flies, and mosquitoes throughout the country.
105.32: He gave them hail as their rain, flames of fire in their land;
105.33: he blasted their vine and their fig tree, and shattered the trees of the country.
105.34: At his word came locusts, hoppers beyond all counting;
105.35: they devoured every green thing in the land, devoured all the produce of the soil.
105.36: He struck all the first-born in their land, the flower of all their manhood;
105.37: he led Israel out with silver and gold; in their tribes there was none who stumbled.
105.38: Egypt was glad at their leaving, for terror of Israel had seized them.
105.39: He spread out a cloud to cover them, and fire to light up the night.
105.40: They asked and he brought them quails, food from heaven to their hearts' content;
105.41: he opened a rock, the waters gushed out, and flowed in dry ground as a river.
105.42: Faithful to his sacred promise, given to his servant Abraham,
105.43: he led out his people with rejoicing, his chosen ones with shouts of joy.
105.44: He gave them the territories of nations, they reaped the fruit of other people's labours,
105.45: on condition that they kept his statutes, and remained obedient to his laws.

106.1: Alleluia! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, his faithful love is everlasting!
106.2: Who can recount all Yahweh's triumphs, who can fully voice his praise?
106.3: How blessed are those who keep to what is just, whose conduct is always upright!
106.4: Remember me, Yahweh, in your love for your people. Come near to me with your saving power,
106.5: let me share the happiness of your chosen ones, let me share the joy of your people, the pride of your heritage.
106.6: Like our ancestors, we have sinned, we have acted wickedly, guiltily;
106.7: our ancestors in Egypt never grasped the meaning of your wonders. They did not bear in mind your countless acts of love, at the Sea of Reeds they defied the Most High;
106.8: but for the sake of his name he saved them, to make known his mighty power.
106.9: At his rebuke the Sea of Reeds dried up, he let them pass through the deep as though it were desert,
106.10: so he saved them from their opponents' clutches, rescued them from the clutches of their enemies.
106.11: The waters enveloped their enemies, not one of whom was left.
106.12: Then they believed what he had said, and sang his praises.
106.13: But they soon forgot his achievements, they did not even wait for his plans;
106.14: they were overwhelmed with greed in the wastelands, in the solitary wastes they challenged God.
106.15: He gave them all they asked for, but struck them with a deep wasting sickness;
106.16: in the camp they grew jealous of Moses, and of Aaron, Yahweh's holy one.
106.17: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, closed in on Abiram's faction;
106.18: fire flamed out against their faction, the renegades were engulfed in flames.
106.19: At Horeb they made a calf, bowed low before cast metal;
106.20: they exchanged their glory for the image of a grass-eating bull.
106.21: They forgot the God who was saving them, who had done great deeds in Egypt,
106.22: such wonders in the land of Ham, such awesome deeds at the Sea of Reeds.
106.23: He thought of putting an end to them, had not Moses, his chosen one, taken a stand in the breach and confronted him, to turn his anger away from destroying them.
106.24: They counted a desirable land for nothing, they put no trust in his promise;
106.25: they stayed in their tents and grumbled, they would not listen to Yahweh's voice.
106.26: So he lifted his hand against them, to strike them down in the desert,
106.27: to strike down their descendants among the nations, to scatter them all over the world.
106.28: They committed themselves to serve Baal-Peor, and ate sacrifices made to lifeless gods.
106.29: They so provoked him by their actions that a plague broke out among them.
106.30: Then up stood Phinehas to intervene, and the plague was checked;
106.31: for this he is the example of uprightness, from age to age for ever.
106.32: At the waters of Meribah they so angered Yahweh, that Moses suffered on their account,
106.33: for they had embittered his spirit, and he spoke without due thought.
106.34: They did not destroy the nations, as Yahweh had told them to do,
106.35: but intermarried with them, and adopted their ways.
106.36: They worshipped those nations' false gods, till they found themselves entrapped,
106.37: and sacrificed their own sons and their daughters to demons.
106.38: Innocent blood they shed, the blood of their sons and daughters; offering them to the idols of Canaan, they polluted the country with blood.
106.39: They defiled themselves by such actions, their behaviour was that of a harlot.
106.40: Yahweh's anger blazed out at his people, his own heritage filled him with disgust.
106.41: He handed them over to the nations, and their opponents became their masters;
106.42: their enemies lorded it over them, crushing them under their rule.
106.43: Time and again he rescued them, but they still defied him deliberately, and sank ever deeper in their guilt;
106.44: even so he took pity on their distress, as soon as he heard them cry out.
106.45: Bearing his covenant with them in mind, he relented in his boundless and faithful love;
106.46: he ensured that they received compassion, in their treatment by all their captors.
106.47: Save us, Yahweh our God, gather us from among the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name, and may glory in praising you.
106.48: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from all eternity and for ever! Let all the people say, 'Amen'.

107.1: Alleluia! Give thanks to Yahweh for he is good, his faithful love lasts for ever.
107.2: So let them say whom Yahweh redeemed, whom he redeemed from the power of their enemies,
107.3: bringing them back from foreign lands, from east and west, north and south.
107.4: They were wandering in the desert, in the wastelands, could find no way to an inhabited city;
107.5: they were hungry and thirsty, their life was ebbing away.
107.6: They cried out to Yahweh in their distress, he rescued them from their plight,
107.7: he set them on the road, straight to an inhabited city.
107.8: Let them thank Yahweh for his faithful love, for his wonders for the children of Adam!
107.9: He has fed the hungry to their hearts' content, filled the starving with good things.
107.10: Sojourners in gloom and shadow dark as death, fettered in misery and chains,
107.11: for defying the orders of Yahweh, for scorning the plan of the Most High-
107.12: he subdued their spirit by hard labour; if they fell there was no one to help.
107.13: They cried out to Yahweh in their distress, he rescued them from their plight,
107.14: he brought them out from gloom and shadow dark as death, and shattered their chains.
107.15: Let them thank Yahweh for his faithful love, for his wonders for the children of Adam!
107.16: He broke open gates of bronze and smashed iron bars.
107.17: Fools for their rebellious ways, wretched because of their sins,
107.18: finding all food repugnant, brought close to the gates of death-
107.19: they cried out to Yahweh in their distress; he rescued them from their plight,
107.20: he sent out his word and cured them, and rescued their life from the abyss.
107.21: Let them thank Yahweh for his faithful love, for his wonders for the children of Adam!
107.22: Let them offer thanksgiving sacrifices, and recount with shouts of joy what he has done!
107.23: Voyagers on the sea in ships, plying their trade on the great ocean,
107.24: have seen the works of Yahweh, his wonders in the deep.
107.25: By his word he raised a storm-wind, lashing up towering waves.
107.26: Up to the sky then down to the depths! Their stomachs were turned to water;
107.27: they staggered and reeled like drunkards, and all their skill went under.
107.28: They cried out to Yahweh in their distress, he rescued them from their plight,
107.29: he reduced the storm to a calm, and all the waters subsided,
107.30: and he brought them, overjoyed at the stillness, to the port where they were bound.
107.31: Let them thank Yahweh for his faithful love, for his wonders for the children of Adam!
107.32: Let them extol him in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the council of elders.
107.33: He has turned rivers into desert, bubbling springs into arid ground,
107.34: fertile country into salt-flats, because the people living there were evil.
107.35: But he has turned desert into stretches of water, arid ground into bubbling springs,
107.36: and has given the hungry a home, where they have built themselves a city.
107.37: There they sow fields and plant vines, and reap a harvest of their produce.
107.38: He blesses them and their numbers increase, he keeps their cattle at full strength.
107.39: Their numbers had fallen, they had grown weak, under pressure of disaster and hardship;
107.40: he covered princes in contempt, left them to wander in trackless wastes.
107.41: But the needy he raises from their misery, makes their families as numerous as sheep.
107.42: At the sight the honest rejoice, and the wicked have nothing to say.
107.43: Who is wise? Such a one should take this to heart, and come to understand Yahweh's faithful love.

108.1: [Song Psalm Of David] My heart is ready, God, I will sing and make music; come, my glory!
108.2: Awake, lyre and harp, I will awake the Dawn!
108.3: I will praise you among the peoples, Yahweh, I will play to you among nations,
108.4: for your faithful love towers to heaven, and your constancy to the clouds.
108.5: Be exalted above the heavens, God. Your glory over the whole earth!
108.6: To rescue those you love, save with your right hand and answer us.
108.7: God has spoken from his sanctuary, 'In triumph I will divide up Shechem, and share out the Valley of Succoth.
108.8: 'Mine is Gilead, mine Manasseh, Ephraim the helmet on my head, Judah my commander's baton,
108.9: 'Moab a bowl for me to wash in, on Edom I plant my sandal, over Philistia I cry victory.'
108.10: Who will lead me against a fortified city, who will guide me into Edom,
108.11: if not you, the God who has rejected us? God, you no longer march with our armies.
108.12: Bring us help in our time of crisis, any human assistance is worthless.
108.13: With God we shall do deeds of valour, he will trample down our enemies.

109.1: [For the choirmaster Of David Psalm] God whom I praise, do not be silent!
109.2: Wicked and deceiving words are being said about me, false accusations are cast in my teeth.
109.3: Words of hate fly all around me, though I give no cause for hostility.
109.4: In return for my friendship they denounce me, and all I can do is pray!
109.5: They repay my kindness with evil, and friendship with hatred.
109.6: 'Set up a wicked man against him as accuser to stand on his right.
109.7: At his trial may he emerge as guilty, even his prayer construed as a crime!
109.8: 'May his life be cut short, someone else take over his office,
109.9: his children be orphaned, his wife be widowed.
109.10: 'May his children wander perpetually, beggars, driven from the ruins of their house,
109.11: a creditor seize all his goods, and strangers make off with his earnings.
109.12: 'May there be none left faithful enough to show him love, no one take pity on his orphans,
109.13: the line of his descendants cut off, his name wiped out in one generation.
109.14: 'May Yahweh never forget the crimes of his ancestors, and his mother's sins not be wiped out;
109.15: may Yahweh keep these constantly in mind, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.'
109.16: He had no thought of being loyal, but hounded the poor and the needy and the broken-hearted to their death.
109.17: He had a taste for cursing; let it recoil on him! No taste for blessing; let it never come his way!
109.18: Cursing has been the uniform he wore; let it soak into him like water, like oil right into his bones.
109.19: Let it be as a robe which envelops him completely, a sash which he always wears.
109.20: Let this be the salary Yahweh pays the accusers who blacken my name.
109.21: Yahweh, treat them as your name demands; as your faithful love is generous, deliver me.
109.22: Poor and needy as I am, my wounds go right to the heart;
109.23: I am passing away like a fading shadow, they have shaken me off like a locust.
109.24: My knees are weak from lack of food, my body lean for lack of fat.
109.25: I have become the butt of their taunts, they shake their heads at the sight of me.
109.26: Help me, Yahweh my God, save me as your faithful love demands.
109.27: Let them know that yours is the saving hand, that this, Yahweh, is your work.
109.28: Let them curse, provided that you bless; let their attacks bring shame to them and joy to your servant!
109.29: Let my accusers be clothed in disgrace, enveloped in a cloak of shame.
109.30: With generous thanks to Yahweh on my lips, I shall praise him before all the people,
109.31: for he stands at the side of the poor, to save their lives from those who sit in judgement on them.

110.1: [Of David Psalm] Yahweh declared to my Lord, 'Take your seat at my right hand, till I have made your enemies your footstool.'
110.2: Yahweh will stretch out the sceptre of your power; from Zion you will rule your foes all around you.
110.3: Royal dignity has been yours from the day of your birth, sacred honour from the womb, from the dawn of your youth.
110.4: Yahweh has sworn an oath he will never retract, you are a priest for ever of the order of Melchizedek.
110.5: At your right hand, Lord, he shatters kings when his anger breaks out.
110.6: He judges nations, heaping up corpses, he breaks heads over the whole wide world.
110.7: He drinks from a stream as he goes, and therefore he holds his head high.

111.1: Alleluia! I give thanks to Yahweh with all my heart, in the meeting-place of honest people, in the assembly.
111.2: Great are the deeds of Yahweh, to be pondered by all who delight in them.
111.3: Full of splendour and majesty his work, his saving justice stands firm for ever.
111.4: He gives us a memorial of his great deeds; Yahweh is mercy and tenderness.
111.5: He gives food to those who fear him, he keeps his covenant ever in mind.
111.6: His works show his people his power in giving them the birthright of the nations.
111.7: The works of his hands are fidelity and justice, all his precepts are trustworthy,
111.8: established for ever and ever, accomplished in fidelity and honesty.
111.9: Deliverance he sends to his people, his covenant he imposes for ever; holy and awesome his name.
111.10: The root of wisdom is fear of Yahweh; those who attain it are wise. His praise will continue for ever.

112.1: Alleluia! How blessed is anyone who fears Yahweh, who delights in his commandments!
112.2: His descendants shall be powerful on earth, the race of the honest shall receive blessings:
112.3: Riches and wealth for his family; his uprightness stands firm for ever.
112.4: For the honest he shines as a lamp in the dark, generous, tender-hearted, and upright.
112.5: All goes well for one who lends generously, who is honest in all his dealing;
112.6: for all time to come he will not stumble, for all time to come the upright will be remembered.
112.7: Bad news holds no fears for him, firm is his heart, trusting in Yahweh.
112.8: His heart held steady, he has no fears, till he can gloat over his enemies.
112.9: To the needy he gives without stint, his uprightness stands firm for ever; his reputation is founded on strength.
112.10: The wicked are vexed at the sight, they grind their teeth and waste away. The desires of the wicked will be frustrated.

113.1: Alleluia! Praise, servants of Yahweh, praise the name of Yahweh.
113.2: Blessed be the name of Yahweh, henceforth and for ever.
113.3: From the rising of the sun to its setting, praised be the name of Yahweh!
113.4: Supreme over all nations is Yahweh, supreme over the heavens his glory.
113.5: Who is like Yahweh our God? His throne is set on high,
113.6: but he stoops to look down on heaven and earth.
113.7: He raises the poor from the dust, he lifts the needy from the dunghill,
113.8: to give them a place among princes, among princes of his people.
113.9: He lets the barren woman be seated at home, the happy mother of sons.

114.1: Alleluia! When Israel came out of Egypt, the House of Jacob from a people of foreign speech,
114.2: Judah became his sanctuary, and Israel his domain.
114.3: The sea fled at the sight, the Jordan turned back,
114.4: the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like sheep.
114.5: Sea, what makes you flee? Jordan, why turn back?
114.6: Why skip like rams, you mountains? Why like sheep, you hills?
114.7: Tremble, earth, at the coming of the Lord, at the coming of the God of Jacob,
114.8: who turns rock into pool, flint into fountain.

115.1: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give the glory, for your faithful love and your constancy!
115.2: Why should the nations ask, 'Where is their God?'
115.3: Our God is in heaven, he creates whatever he chooses.
115.4: They have idols of silver and gold, made by human hands.
115.5: These have mouths but say nothing, have eyes but see nothing,
115.6: have ears but hear nothing, have noses but smell nothing.
115.7: They have hands but cannot feel, have feet but cannot walk, no sound comes from their throats.
115.8: Their makers will end up like them, and all who rely on them.
115.9: House of Israel, rely on Yahweh; he is their help and their shield.
115.10: House of Aaron, rely on Yahweh; he is their help and their shield.
115.11: You who fear Yahweh, rely on Yahweh; he is their help and their shield.
115.12: Yahweh will keep us in mind, he will bless, he will bless the House of Israel, he will bless the House of Aaron,
115.13: he will bless those who fear Yahweh, small and great alike.
115.14: May Yahweh add to your numbers, yours and your children's too!
115.15: May you be blessed by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
115.16: Heaven belongs to Yahweh, but earth he has given to the children of Adam.
115.17: The dead cannot praise Yahweh, those who sink into silence,
115.18: but we, the living, shall bless Yahweh, henceforth and for ever.

116.1: Alleluia! I am filled with love when Yahweh listens to the sound of my prayer,
116.2: when he bends down to hear me, as I call.
116.3: The bonds of death were all round me, the snares of Sheol held me fast; distress and anguish held me in their grip,
116.4: I called on the name of Yahweh. Deliver me, Yahweh, I beg you.
116.5: Yahweh is merciful and upright, our God is tenderness.
116.6: Yahweh looks after the simple, when I was brought low he gave me strength.
116.7: My heart, be at peace once again, for Yahweh has treated you generously.
116.8: He has rescued me from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.
116.9: I shall pass my life in the presence of Yahweh, in the land of the living.
116.10: My trust does not fail even when I say, 'I am completely wretched.'
116.11: In my terror I said, 'No human being can be relied on.'
116.12: What return can I make to Yahweh for his generosity to me?
116.13: I shall take up the cup of salvation and call on the name of Yahweh.
116.14: I shall fulfil my vows to Yahweh, witnessed by all his people.
116.15: Costly in Yahweh's sight is the death of his faithful.
116.16: I beg you, Yahweh! I am your servant, I am your servant and my mother was your servant; you have undone my fetters.
116.17: I shall offer you a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of Yahweh.
116.18: I shall fulfil my vows to Yahweh, witnessed by all his people,
116.19: in the courts of the house of Yahweh, in your very heart, Jerusalem.

117.1: Alleluia! Praise Yahweh, all nations, extol him, all peoples,
117.2: for his faithful love is strong and his constancy never-ending.

118.1: Alleluia! Give thanks to Yahweh for he is good, for his faithful love endures for ever.
118.2: Let the House of Israel say, 'His faithful love endures for ever.'
118.3: Let the House of Aaron say, 'His faithful love endures for ever.'
118.4: Let those who fear Yahweh say, 'His faithful love endures for ever.'
118.5: In my distress I called to Yahweh, he heard me and brought me relief.
118.6: With Yahweh on my side I fear nothing; what can human beings do to me?
118.7: With Yahweh on my side as my help, I gloat over my enemies.
118.8: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh than to rely on human beings;
118.9: better to take refuge in Yahweh than to rely on princes.
118.10: Nations were swarming around me, in the name of Yahweh I cut them down;
118.11: they swarmed around me, pressing upon me, in the name of Yahweh I cut them down.
118.12: They swarmed around me like bees, they flared up like a brushwood fire, in the name of Yahweh I cut them down.
118.13: I was pushed hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh came to my help.
118.14: Yahweh is my strength and my song, he has been my Saviour.
118.15: Shouts of joy and salvation, in the tents of the upright, 'Yahweh's right hand is triumphant,
118.16: Yahweh's right hand is victorious, Yahweh's right hand is triumphant!'
118.17: I shall not die, I shall live to recount the great deeds of Yahweh.
118.18: Though Yahweh punished me sternly, he has not abandoned me to death.
118.19: Open for me the gates of saving justice, I shall go in and thank Yahweh.
118.20: This is the gate of Yahweh, where the upright go in.
118.21: I thank you for hearing me, and making yourself my Saviour.
118.22: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone;
118.23: This is Yahweh's doing, and we marvel at it.
118.24: This is the day which Yahweh has made, a day for us to rejoice and be glad.
118.25: We beg you, Yahweh, save us, we beg you, Yahweh, give us victory!
118.26: Blessed in the name of Yahweh is he who is coming! We bless you from the house of Yahweh.
118.27: Yahweh is God, he gives us light. Link your processions, branches in hand, up to the horns of the altar.
118.28: You are my God, I thank you, all praise to you, my God. I thank you for hearing me, and making yourself my Saviour.
118.29: Give thanks to Yahweh for he is good, for his faithful love endures for ever.

119.1: How blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of Yahweh!
119.2: Blessed are those who observe his instructions, who seek him with all their hearts,
119.3: and, doing no evil, who walk in his ways.
119.4: You lay down your precepts to be carefully kept.
119.5: May my ways be steady in doing your will.
119.6: Then I shall not be shamed, if my gaze is fixed on your commandments.
119.7: I thank you with a sincere heart for teaching me your upright judgements.
119.8: I shall do your will; do not ever abandon me wholly.
119.9: How can a young man keep his way spotless? By keeping your words.
119.10: With all my heart I seek you, do not let me stray from your commandments.
119.11: In my heart I treasure your promises, to avoid sinning against you.
119.12: Blessed are you, Yahweh, teach me your will!
119.13: With my lips I have repeated all the judgements you have given.
119.14: In the way of your instructions lies my joy, a joy beyond all wealth.
119.15: I will ponder your precepts and fix my gaze on your paths.
119.16: I find my delight in your will, I do not forget your words.
119.17: Be generous to your servant and I shall live, and shall keep your words.
119.18: Open my eyes and I shall fix my gaze on the wonders of your Law.
119.19: Wayfarer though I am on the earth, do not hide your commandments from me.
119.20: My heart is pining away with longing at all times for your judgements.
119.21: You have rebuked the arrogant, the accursed, who stray from your commandments.
119.22: Set me free from taunts and contempt since I observe your instructions.
119.23: Though princes sit plotting against me, your servant keeps pondering your will.
119.24: Your instructions are my delight, your wishes my counsellors.
119.25: Down in the dust I lie prostrate; true to your word, revive me.
119.26: I tell you my ways and you answer me; teach me your wishes.
119.27: Show me the way of your precepts, that I may reflect on your wonders.
119.28: I am melting away for grief; true to your word, raise me up.
119.29: Keep me far from the way of deceit, grant me the grace of your Law.
119.30: I have chosen the way of constancy, I have moulded myself to your judgements.
119.31: I cling to your instructions, Yahweh, do not disappoint me.
119.32: I run the way of your commandments, for you have given me freedom of heart.
119.33: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your will, and I will observe it.
119.34: Give me understanding and I will observe your Law, and keep it wholeheartedly.
119.35: Guide me in the way of your commandments, for my delight is there.
119.36: Bend my heart to your instructions, not to selfish gain.
119.37: Avert my eyes from pointless images, by your word give me life.
119.38: Keep your promise to your servant so that all may hold you in awe.
119.39: Avert the taunts that I dread, for your judgements are generous.
119.40: See how I yearn for your precepts; in your saving justice give me life.
119.41: Let your faithful love come to me, Yahweh, true to your promise, save me!
119.42: Give me an answer to the taunts against me, since I rely on your word.
119.43: Do not deprive me of that faithful word, since my hope lies in your judgements.
119.44: I shall keep your Law without fail for ever and ever.
119.45: I shall live in all freedom because I have sought your precepts.
119.46: I shall speak of your instructions before kings and will not be shamed.
119.47: Your commandments fill me with delight, I love them dearly.
119.48: I stretch out my hands to your commandments that I love, and I ponder your judgements.
119.49: Keep in mind your promise to your servant on which I have built my hope.
119.50: It is my comfort in distress, that your promise gives me life.
119.51: Endlessly the arrogant have jeered at me, but I have not swerved from your Law.
119.52: I have kept your age -- old judgements in mind, Yahweh, and I am comforted.
119.53: Fury grips me when I see the wicked who abandon your Law.
119.54: Your judgements are my song where I live in exile.
119.55: All night, Yahweh, I hold your name in mind, I keep your Law.
119.56: This is what it means to me, observing your precepts.
119.57: My task, I have said, Yahweh, is to keep your word.
119.58: Wholeheartedly I entreat your favour; true to your promise, take pity on me!
119.59: I have reflected on my ways, and I turn my steps to your instructions.
119.60: I hurry without delay to keep your commandments.
119.61: Though caught in the snares of the wicked, I do not forget your Law.
119.62: At midnight I rise to praise you for your upright judgements.
119.63: I am a friend to all who fear you and keep your precepts.
119.64: Your faithful love fills the earth, Yahweh, teach me your judgements.
119.65: You have been generous to your servant, Yahweh, true to your promise.
119.66: Teach me judgement and knowledge, for I rely on your commandments.
119.67: Before I was punished I used to go astray, but now I keep to your promise.
119.68: You are generous and act generously, teach me your will.
119.69: The arrogant blacken me with lies though I wholeheartedly observe your precepts.
119.70: Their hearts are gross like rich fat, but my delight is in your Law.
119.71: It was good for me that I had to suffer, the better to learn your judgements.
119.72: The Law you have uttered is more precious to me than all the wealth in the world.
119.73: Your hands have made me and held me firm, give me understanding and I shall learn your commandments.
119.74: Those who fear you rejoice at the sight of me since I put my hope in your word.
119.75: I know, Yahweh, that your judgements are upright, and in punishing me you show your constancy.
119.76: Your faithful love must be my consolation, as you have promised your servant.
119.77: Treat me with tenderness and I shall live, for your Law is my delight.
119.78: Let the arrogant who tell lies against me be shamed, while I ponder your precepts.
119.79: Let those who fear you rally to me, those who understand your instructions.
119.80: My heart shall be faultless towards your will; then I shall not be ashamed.
119.81: I shall wear myself out for your salvation, for your word is my hope.
119.82: My eyes, too, are worn out waiting for your promise, when will you have pity on me?
119.83: For I am like a smoked wineskin, but I do not forget your will.
119.84: How long has your servant to live? When will you bring my persecutors to judgement?
119.85: The arrogant have dug pitfalls for me in defiance of your Law.
119.86: All your commandments show constancy. Help me when they pursue me dishonestly.
119.87: They have almost annihilated me on earth, but I have not deserted your precepts.
119.88: True to your faithful love, give me life, and I shall keep the instructions you have laid down.
119.89: For ever, Yahweh, your word is planted firm in heaven.
119.90: Your constancy endures from age to age; you established the earth and it stands firm.
119.91: Through your judgements all stands firm to this day, for all creation is your servant.
119.92: Had your Law not been my delight, I would have perished in my misery.
119.93: I shall never forget your precepts, for by them you have given me life.
119.94: I am yours, save me, for I seek your precepts.
119.95: The wicked may hope to destroy me, but all my thought is of your instructions.
119.96: I have seen that all perfection is finite, but your commandment has no limit.
119.97: How I love your Law! I ponder it all day long.
119.98: You make me wiser than my enemies by your commandment which is mine for ever.
119.99: I am wiser than all my teachers because I ponder your instructions.
119.100: I have more understanding than the aged because I keep your precepts.
119.101: I restrain my foot from evil paths to keep your word.
119.102: I do not turn aside from your judgements, because you yourself have instructed me.
119.103: How pleasant your promise to my palate, sweeter than honey in my mouth!
119.104: From your precepts I learn wisdom, so I hate all deceptive ways.
119.105: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.
119.106: I have sworn -- and shall maintain it -- to keep your upright judgements.
119.107: I am utterly wretched, Yahweh; true to your promise, give me life.
119.108: Accept, Yahweh, the tribute from my mouth, and teach me your judgements.
119.109: My life is in your hands perpetually, I do not forget your Law.
119.110: The wicked have laid out a snare for me, but I have not strayed from your precepts.
119.111: Your instructions are my eternal heritage, they are the joy of my heart.
119.112: I devote myself to obeying your statutes, their recompense is eternal.
119.113: I hate a divided heart, I love your Law.
119.114: You are my refuge and shield, I put my hope in your word.
119.115: Leave me alone, you wicked, I shall observe the commandments of my God.
119.116: True to your word, support me and I shall live; do not disappoint me of my hope.
119.117: Uphold me and I shall be saved, my gaze fixed on your will.
119.118: You shake off all who stray from your will; deceit fills their horizon.
119.119: In your sight all the wicked of the earth are like rust, so I love your instructions.
119.120: My whole body trembles before you, your judgements fill me with fear.
119.121: All my conduct has been just and upright, do not hand me over to my oppressors.
119.122: Guarantee the well-being of your servant, do not let the proud oppress me.
119.123: My eyes are languishing for your salvation and for the saving justice you have promised.
119.124: Show your faithful love to your servant, teach me your judgements.
119.125: Your servant am I; give me understanding and I shall know your instructions.
119.126: It is time to take action, Yahweh, your Law is being broken.
119.127: So I love your commandments more than gold, purest gold.
119.128: So I rule my life by your precepts, I hate all deceptive paths.
119.129: Wonderful are your instructions, so I observe them.
119.130: As your word unfolds it gives light, and even the simple understand.
119.131: I open wide my mouth, panting eagerly for your commandments.
119.132: Turn to me, pity me; those who love your name deserve it.
119.133: Keep my steps firm in your promise; that no evil may triumph over me.
119.134: Rescue me from human oppression, and I will observe your precepts.
119.135: Let your face shine on your servant, teach me your will.
119.136: My eyes stream with tears because your Law is disregarded.
119.137: You are upright, Yahweh, and your judgements are honest.
119.138: You impose uprightness as a witness to yourself, it is constancy itself.
119.139: My zeal is burning me up because my oppressors forget your word.
119.140: Your promise is well tested, your servant holds it dear.
119.141: Puny and despised as I am, I do not forget your precepts.
119.142: Your saving justice is for ever just, and your Law is trustworthy.
119.143: Though anguish and distress grip me your commandments are my delight.
119.144: Your instructions are upright for ever, give me understanding and I shall live.
119.145: I call with all my heart; answer me, Yahweh, and I will observe your judgements.
119.146: I call to you; save me, and I will keep your instructions.
119.147: I am awake before dawn to cry for help, I put my hope in your word.
119.148: My eyes are awake before each watch of the night, to ponder your promise.
119.149: In your faithful love, Yahweh, listen to my voice, let your judgements give me life.
119.150: My pursuers are coming closer to their wicked designs, and further from your Law.
119.151: You are close to me, Yahweh, and all your commandments are true.
119.152: Long have I known that your instructions were laid down to last for ever.
119.153: Look at my suffering and rescue me, for I do not forget your Law.
119.154: Plead my cause and defend me; as you promised, give me life.
119.155: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek your will.
119.156: Your kindnesses to me are countless, Yahweh; true to your judgements, give me life.
119.157: Though my enemies and oppressors are countless, I do not turn aside from your instructions.
119.158: The sight of these renegades appals me; they do not observe your promise.
119.159: See how I love your precepts; true to your faithful love, give me life.
119.160: Faithfulness is the essence of your word, your upright judgements hold good for ever.
119.161: Though princes hound me unprovoked, what fills me with awe is your word.
119.162: I rejoice in your promise like one who finds a vast treasure.
119.163: Falsehood I hate and detest, my love is for your Law.
119.164: Seven times a day I praise you for your upright judgements.
119.165: Great peace for those who love your Law; no stumbling-blocks for them!
119.166: I am waiting for your salvation, Yahweh, I fulfil your commandments.
119.167: I observe your instructions, I love them dearly.
119.168: I observe your precepts, your judgements, for all my ways are before you.
119.169: May my cry approach your presence, Yahweh; by your word give me understanding.
119.170: May my prayer come into your presence, rescue me as you have promised.
119.171: May my lips proclaim your praise, for you teach me your will.
119.172: May my tongue recite your promise, for all your commandments are upright.
119.173: May your hand be there to help me, since I have chosen your precepts.
119.174: I long for your salvation, Yahweh, your Law is my delight.
119.175: May I live only to praise you, may your judgements be my help.
119.176: I am wandering like a lost sheep, come and look for your servant, for I have not forgotten your commandments.

120.1: [Song of Ascents *{* The Songs of Ascents (Pss 120-134) were sung by pilgrims on their way up to Jerusalem.} ] To Yahweh when I am in trouble I call and he answers me.
120.2: Yahweh, save me from lying lips and a treacherous tongue!
120.3: What will he repay you, what more, treacherous tongue?
120.4: War-arrows made sharp over red-hot charcoal.
120.5: How wretched I am, living in Meshech, dwelling in the tents of Kedar!
120.6: Too long have I lived among people who hate peace.
120.7: When I speak of peace they are all for war!

121.1: [Song of Ascents] I lift up my eyes to the mountains; where is my help to come from?
121.2: My help comes from Yahweh who made heaven and earth.
121.3: May he save your foot from stumbling; may he, your guardian, not fall asleep!
121.4: You see -- he neither sleeps nor slumbers, the guardian of Israel.
121.5: Yahweh is your guardian, your shade, Yahweh, at your right hand.
121.6: By day the sun will not strike you, nor the moon by night.
121.7: Yahweh guards you from all harm Yahweh guards your life,
121.8: Yahweh guards your comings and goings, henceforth and for ever.

122.1: [Song of Ascents Of David] I rejoiced that they said to me, 'Let us go to the house of Yahweh.'
122.2: At last our feet are standing at your gates, Jerusalem!
122.3: Jerusalem, built as a city, in one united whole,
122.4: there the tribes go up, the tribes of Yahweh, a sign for Israel to give thanks to the name of Yahweh.
122.5: For there are set the thrones of judgement, the thrones of the house of David.
122.6: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem, prosperity for your homes!
122.7: Peace within your walls, prosperity in your palaces!
122.8: For love of my brothers and my friends I will say, 'Peace upon you!'
122.9: For love of the house of Yahweh our God I will pray for your well-being.

123.1: [Song of Ascents] I lift up my eyes to you who are enthroned in heaven.
123.2: Just as the eyes of slaves are on their masters' hand, or the eyes of a slave-girl on the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on Yahweh our God, for him to take pity on us.
123.3: Have pity on us, Yahweh, have pity, for we have had our full share of scorn,
123.4: more than our share of jeers from the complacent. (Scorn is for the proud.)

124.1: [Song of Ascents Of David] If Yahweh had not been on our side -- let Israel repeat it-
124.2: if Yahweh had not been on our side when people attacked us,
124.3: they would have swallowed us alive in the heat of their anger.
124.4: Then water was washing us away, a torrent running right over us;
124.5: running right over us then were turbulent waters.
124.6: Blessed be Yahweh for not letting us fall a prey to their teeth!
124.7: We escaped like a bird from the fowlers' net. The net was broken and we escaped;
124.8: our help is in the name of Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

125.1: [Song of Ascents] Whoever trusts in Yahweh is like Mount Zion: unshakeable, it stands for ever.
125.2: Jerusalem! The mountains encircle her: so Yahweh encircles his people, henceforth and for ever.
125.3: The sceptre of the wicked will not come to rest over the heritage of the upright; or the upright might set their own hands to evil.
125.4: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to the sincere at heart.
125.5: But the crooked, the twisted, turn them away, Yahweh, with evil-doers. Peace to Israel!

126.1: [Song of Ascents] When Yahweh brought back Zion's captives we lived in a dream;
126.2: then our mouths filled with laughter, and our lips with song. Then the nations kept saying, 'What great deeds Yahweh has done for them!'
126.3: Yes, Yahweh did great deeds for us, and we were overjoyed.
126.4: Bring back, Yahweh, our people from captivity like torrents in the Negeb!
126.5: Those who sow in tears sing as they reap.
126.6: He went off, went off weeping, carrying the seed. He comes back, comes back singing, bringing in his sheaves.

127.1: [Song of Ascents Of Solomon] If Yahweh does not build a house in vain do its builders toil. If Yahweh does not guard a city in vain does its guard keep watch.
127.2: In vain you get up earlier, and put off going to bed, sweating to make a living, since it is he who provides for his beloved as they sleep.
127.3: Sons are a birthright from Yahweh, children are a reward from him.
127.4: Like arrows in a warrior's hand are the sons you father when young.
127.5: How blessed is the man who has filled his quiver with them; in dispute with his enemies at the city gate he will not be worsted.

128.1: [Song of Ascents] How blessed are all who fear Yahweh, who walk in his ways!
128.2: Your own labours will yield you a living, happy and prosperous will you be.
128.3: Your wife a fruitful vine in the inner places of your house. Your children round your table like shoots of an olive tree.
128.4: Such are the blessings that fall on those who fear Yahweh.
128.5: May Yahweh bless you from Zion! May you see Jerusalem prosper all the days of your life,
128.6: and live to see your children's children! Peace to Israel!

129.1: [Song of Ascents] Often as men have attacked me since I was young -- let Israel repeat it-
129.2: often as men have attacked me since I was young, they have never overcome me.
129.3: On my back ploughmen have set to work, making long furrows,
129.4: but Yahweh the upright has shattered the yoke of the wicked.
129.5: Let all who hate Zion be thrown back in confusion,
129.6: let them be like grass on a roof, dried up before it is cut,
129.7: never to fill the reaper's arm nor the binder's lap.
129.8: And no passer-by will say, 'The blessing of Yahweh be on you! 'We bless you in the name of Yahweh.'

130.1: [Song of Ascents] From the depths I call to you, Yahweh:
130.2: Lord, hear my cry. Listen attentively to the sound of my pleading!
130.3: If you kept a record of our sins, Lord, who could stand their ground?
130.4: But with you is forgiveness, that you may be revered.
130.5: I rely, my whole being relies, Yahweh, on your promise.
130.6: My whole being hopes in the Lord, more than watchmen for daybreak; more than watchmen for daybreak
130.7: let Israel hope in Yahweh. For with Yahweh is faithful love, with him generous ransom;
130.8: and he will ransom Israel from all its sins.

131.1: [Song of Ascents] Yahweh, my heart is not haughty, I do not set my sights too high. I have taken no part in great affairs, in wonders beyond my scope.
131.2: No, I hold myself in quiet and silence, like a little child in its mother's arms, like a little child, so I keep myself.
131.3: Let Israel hope in Yahweh henceforth and for ever.

132.1: [Song of Ascents] Yahweh, remember David and all the hardships he endured,
132.2: the oath he swore to Yahweh, his vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:
132.3: 'I will not enter tent or house, will not climb into bed,
132.4: will not allow myself to sleep, not even to close my eyes,
132.5: till I have found a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob!'
132.6: Listen, we heard of it in Ephrathah, we found it at Forest-Fields.
132.7: Let us go into his dwelling-place, and worship at his footstool.
132.8: Go up, Yahweh, to your resting-place, you and the ark of your strength.
132.9: Your priests are robed in saving justice, your faithful are shouting for joy.
132.10: For the sake of your servant David, do not reject your anointed.
132.11: Yahweh has sworn to David, and will always remain true to his word, 'I promise that I will set a son of yours upon your throne.
132.12: If your sons observe my covenant and the instructions I have taught them, their sons too for evermore will occupy your throne.'
132.13: For Yahweh has chosen Zion, he has desired it as a home.
132.14: 'Here shall I rest for evermore, here shall I make my home as I have wished.
132.15: 'I shall generously bless her produce, give her needy their fill of food,
132.16: I shall clothe her priests with salvation, and her faithful will sing aloud for joy.
132.17: 'There I shall raise up a line of descendants for David, light a lamp for my anointed;
132.18: I shall clothe his enemies with shame, while his own crown shall flourish.'

133.1: [Song of Ascents] How good, how delightful it is to live as brothers all together!
133.2: It is like a fine oil on the head, running down the beard, running down Aaron's beard, onto the collar of his robes.
133.3: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the heights of Zion; for there Yahweh bestows his blessing, everlasting life.

134.1: [Song of Ascents] Come, bless Yahweh, all you who serve Yahweh, serving in the house of Yahweh, in the courts of the house of our God. Through the night watches
134.2: stretch out your hands towards the sanctuary and bless Yahweh.
134.3: May Yahweh bless you from Zion, he who made heaven and earth!

135.1: Alleluia! Praise the name of Yahweh, you who serve Yahweh, praise him,
135.2: serving in the house of Yahweh, in the courts of the house of our God.
135.3: Praise Yahweh, for Yahweh is good, make music for his name -- it brings joy-
135.4: for Yahweh has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel as his own possession.
135.5: For I know that Yahweh is great, our Lord is above all gods.
135.6: Yahweh does whatever he pleases in heaven, on earth, in the waters and all the depths.
135.7: He summons up clouds from the borders of earth, sends rain with lightning-flashes, and brings the wind out of his storehouse.
135.8: He struck the first-born in Egypt, man and beast alike,
135.9: he sent signs and wonders into the heart of Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his officials.
135.10: He struck down many nations, he slaughtered mighty kings,
135.11: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan.
135.12: He gave their land as a birthright, a birthright to his people Israel.
135.13: Yahweh, your name endures for ever, Yahweh, your memory is fresh from age to age.
135.14: For Yahweh vindicates his people, feels compassion for his servants.
135.15: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by human hands.
135.16: These have mouths but say nothing, have eyes but see nothing,
135.17: have ears but hear nothing, and they have no breath in their mouths.
135.18: Their makers will end up like them, everyone who relies on them.
135.19: House of Israel, bless Yahweh, House of Aaron, bless Yahweh,
135.20: House of Levi, bless Yahweh, you who fear Yahweh, bless Yahweh.
135.21: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, he who dwells in Jerusalem!

136.1: Alleluia! Give thanks to Yahweh for he is good, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.2: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.3: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.4: He alone works wonders, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.5: In wisdom he made the heavens, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.6: He set the earth firm on the waters, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.7: He made the great lights, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.8: The sun to rule the day, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.9: Moon and stars to rule the night, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.10: He struck down the first-born of Egypt, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.11: He brought Israel out from among them, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.12: With mighty hand and outstretched arm, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.13: He split the Sea of Reeds in two, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.14: Let Israel pass through the middle, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.15: And drowned Pharaoh and all his army, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.16: He led his people through the desert, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.17: He struck down mighty kings, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.18: Slaughtered famous kings, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.19: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.20: And Og king of Bashan, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.21: He gave their land as a birthright, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.22: A birthright to his servant Israel, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.23: He kept us in mind when we were humbled, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.24: And rescued us from our enemies, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.25: He provides food for all living creatures, for his faithful love endures for ever.
136.26: Give thanks to the God of heaven, for his faithful love endures for ever.

137.1: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept at the memory of Zion.
137.2: On the poplars there we had hung up our harps.
137.3: For there our gaolers had asked us to sing them a song, our captors to make merry, 'Sing us one of the songs of Zion.'
137.4: How could we sing a song of Yahweh on alien soil?
137.5: If I forget you, Jerusalem, may my right hand wither!
137.6: May my tongue remain stuck to my palate if I do not keep you in mind, if I do not count Jerusalem the greatest of my joys.
137.7: Remember, Yahweh, to the Edomites' cost, the day of Jerusalem, how they said, 'Down with it! Rase it to the ground!'
137.8: Daughter of Babel, doomed to destruction, a blessing on anyone who treats you as you treated us,
137.9: a blessing on anyone who seizes your babies and shatters them against a rock!

138.1: [Of David] I thank you, Yahweh, with all my heart, for you have listened to the cry I uttered. In the presence of angels I sing to you,
138.2: I bow down before your holy Temple. I praise your name for your faithful love and your constancy; your promises surpass even your fame.
138.3: You heard me on the day when I called, and you gave new strength to my heart.
138.4: All the kings of the earth give thanks to you, Yahweh, when they hear the promises you make;
138.5: they sing of Yahweh's ways, 'Great is the glory of Yahweh!'
138.6: Sublime as he is, Yahweh looks on the humble, the proud he picks out from afar.
138.7: Though I live surrounded by trouble you give me life -- to my enemies' fury! You stretch out your right hand and save me,
138.8: Yahweh will do all things for me. Yahweh, your faithful love endures for ever, do not abandon what you have made.

139.1: [For the choirmaster Of David Psalm] Yahweh, you examine me and know me,
139.2: you know when I sit, when I rise, you understand my thoughts from afar.
139.3: You watch when I walk or lie down, you know every detail of my conduct.
139.4: A word is not yet on my tongue before you, Yahweh, know all about it.
139.5: You fence me in, behind and in front, you have laid your hand upon me.
139.6: Such amazing knowledge is beyond me, a height to which I cannot attain.
139.7: Where shall I go to escape your spirit? Where shall I flee from your presence?
139.8: If I scale the heavens you are there, if I lie flat in Sheol, there you are.
139.9: If I speed away on the wings of the dawn, if I dwell beyond the ocean,
139.10: even there your hand will be guiding me, your right hand holding me fast.
139.11: I will say, 'Let the darkness cover me, and the night wrap itself around me,'
139.12: even darkness to you is not dark, and night is as clear as the day.
139.13: You created my inmost self, knit me together in my mother's womb.
139.14: For so many marvels I thank you; a wonder am I, and all your works are wonders. You knew me through and through,
139.15: my being held no secrets from you, when I was being formed in secret, textured in the depths of the earth.
139.16: Your eyes could see my embryo. In your book all my days were inscribed, every one that was fixed is there.
139.17: How hard for me to grasp your thoughts, how many, God, there are!
139.18: If I count them, they are more than the grains of sand; if I come to an end, I am still with you.
139.19: If only, God, you would kill the wicked!-Men of violence, keep away from me!-
139.20: those who speak blasphemously about you, and take no account of your thoughts.
139.21: Yahweh, do I not hate those who hate you, and loathe those who defy you?
139.22: My hate for them has no limits, I regard them as my own enemies.
139.23: God, examine me and know my heart, test me and know my concerns.
139.24: Make sure that I am not on my way to ruin, and guide me on the road of eternity.

140.1: [For the choirmaster Psalm Of David] Rescue me, Yahweh, from evil men, protect me from violent men,
140.2: whose heart is bent on malice, day after day they harbour strife;
140.3: their tongues as barbed as a serpent's, viper's venom behind their lips.Pause
140.4: Keep me, Yahweh, from the clutches of the wicked, protect me from violent men, who are bent on making me stumble,laying out snares where I walk,
140.5: in their arrogance hiding pitfall and nooseto trap me as I pass.Pause
140.6: I said to Yahweh, 'You are my God.' Listen, Yahweh, to the sound of my prayer.
140.7: Yahweh my Lord, my saving strength, you shield my head when battle comes.
140.8: Yahweh, do not grant the wicked their wishes, do not let their plots succeed.Pause Do not let my attackers
140.9: prevail, but let them be overwhelmed by their own malice.
140.10: May red-hot embers rain down on them, may they be flung into the mire once and for all.
140.11: May the slanderer find no rest anywhere, may evil hunt down violent men implacably.
140.12: I know that Yahweh will give judgement for the wretched, justice for the needy.
140.13: The upright shall praise your name, the honest dwell in your presence.

141.1: [Psalm Of David] Yahweh, I am calling, hurry to me, listen to my voice when I call to you.
141.2: May my prayer be like incense in your presence, my uplifted hands like the evening sacrifice.
141.3: Yahweh, mount a guard over my mouth, a guard at the door of my lips.
141.4: Check any impulse to speak evil, to share the foul deeds of evil-doers. I shall not sample their delights!
141.5: May the upright correct me with a friend's rebuke; but the wicked shall never anoint my head with oil, for that would make me party to their crimes.
141.6: They are delivered into the power of the rock, their judge, those who took pleasure in hearing me say,
141.7: 'Like a shattered millstone on the ground our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.'
141.8: To you, Yahweh, I turn my eyes, in you I take refuge, do not leave me unprotected.
141.9: Save me from the traps that are set for me, the snares of evil-doers.
141.10: Let the wicked fall each into his own net, while I pass on my way.

142.1: [Psalm Of David When he was in the cave Prayer] To Yahweh I cry out with my plea. To Yahweh I cry out with entreaty.
142.2: I pour out my worry in his presence, in his presence I unfold my troubles.
142.3: However faint my spirit; you are watching over my path. On the road I have to travel they have hidden a trap for me.
142.4: Look on my right and see -- there is no one who recognises me. All refuge is denied me, no one cares whether I live or die.
142.5: I cry out to you, Yahweh, I affirm, 'You are my refuge, my share in the land of the living!'
142.6: Listen to my calling, for I am miserably weak. Rescue me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
142.7: Lead me out of prison that I may praise your name. The upright gather round me because of your generosity to me.

143.1: [Psalm Of David] Yahweh, hear my prayer, listen to my pleading; in your constancy answer me, in your saving justice;
143.2: do not put your servant on trial, for no one living can be found guiltless at your tribunal.
143.3: An enemy is in deadly pursuit, crushing me into the ground, forcing me to live in darkness, like those long dead.
143.4: My spirit is faint, and within me my heart is numb with fear.
143.5: I recall the days of old, reflecting on all your deeds, I ponder the works of your hands.
143.6: I stretch out my hands to you, my heart like a land thirsty for you.Pause
143.7: Answer me quickly, Yahweh, my spirit is worn out; do not turn away your face from me, or I shall be like those who sink into oblivion.
143.8: Let dawn bring news of your faithful love, for I place my trust in you; show me the road I must travel for you to relieve my heart.
143.9: Rescue me from my enemies, Yahweh, since in you I find protection.
143.10: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. May your generous spirit lead me on even ground.
143.11: Yahweh, for the sake of your name, in your saving justice give me life, rescue me from distress.
143.12: In your faithful love annihilate my enemies, destroy all those who oppress me, for I am your servant.

144.1: [Of David] Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who trains my hands for war and my fingers for battle,
144.2: my faithful love, my bastion, my citadel, my Saviour; I shelter behind him, my shield, he makes the peoples submit to me.
144.3: Yahweh, what is a human being for you to notice, a child of Adam for you to think about?
144.4: Human life, a mere puff of wind, days as fleeting as a shadow.
144.5: Yahweh, part the heavens and come down, touch the mountains, make them smoke.
144.6: Scatter them with continuous lightning-flashes, rout them with a volley of your arrows.
144.7: Stretch down your hand from above, save me, rescue me from deep waters, from the clutches of foreigners,
144.8: whose every word is worthless, whose right hand is raised in perjury.
144.9: God, I sing to you a new song, I play to you on the ten-stringed lyre,
144.10: for you give kings their victories, you rescue your servant David. From the sword of evil
144.11: save me, rescue me from the clutches of foreigners whose every word is worthless, whose right hand testifies to falsehood.
144.12: May our sons be like plants growing tall from their earliest days, our daughters like pillars carved fit for a palace,
144.13: our barns filled to overflowing with every kind of crop, the sheep in our pastures be numbered in thousands and tens of thousands,
144.14: our cattle well fed, free of raids and pillage, free of outcry in our streets.
144.15: How blessed the nation of whom this is true, blessed the nation whose God is Yahweh!

145.1: [Hymn of Praise Of David] I shall praise you to the heights, God my King, I shall bless your name for ever and ever.
145.2: Day after day I shall bless you, I shall praise your name for ever and ever.
145.3: Great is Yahweh and worthy of all praise, his greatness beyond all reckoning.
145.4: Each age will praise your deeds to the next, proclaiming your mighty works.
145.5: Your renown is the splendour of your glory, I will ponder the story of your wonders.
145.6: They will speak of your awesome power, and I shall recount your greatness.
145.7: They will bring out the memory of your great generosity, and joyfully acclaim your saving justice.
145.8: Yahweh is tenderness and pity, slow to anger, full of faithful love.
145.9: Yahweh is generous to all, his tenderness embraces all his creatures.
145.10: All your creatures shall thank you, Yahweh, and your faithful shall bless you.
145.11: They shall speak of the glory of your kingship and tell of your might,
145.12: making known your mighty deeds to the children of Adam, the glory and majesty of your kingship.
145.13: Your kingship is a kingship for ever, your reign lasts from age to age. Yahweh is trustworthy in all his words, and upright in all his deeds.
145.14: Yahweh supports all who stumble, lifts up those who are bowed down.
145.15: All look to you in hope and you feed them with the food of the season.
145.16: And, with generous hand, you satisfy the desires of every living creature.
145.17: Upright in all that he does, Yahweh acts only in faithful love.
145.18: He is close to all who call upon him, all who call on him from the heart.
145.19: He fulfils the desires of all who fear him, he hears their cry and he saves them.
145.20: Yahweh guards all who love him, but all the wicked he destroys.
145.21: My mouth shall always praise Yahweh, let every creature bless his holy name for ever and ever.

146.2: I will praise Yahweh all my life, I will make music to my God as long as I live.
146.3: Do not put your trust in princes, in any child of Adam, who has no power to save.
146.4: When his spirit goes forth he returns to the earth, on that very day all his plans come to nothing.
146.5: How blessed is he who has Jacob's God to help him, his hope is in Yahweh his God,
146.6: who made heaven and earth, the sea and all that is in them. He keeps faith for ever,
146.7: gives justice to the oppressed, gives food to the hungry; Yahweh sets prisoners free.
146.8: Yahweh gives sight to the blind, lifts up those who are bowed down.
146.9: Yahweh protects the stranger, he sustains the orphan and the widow. Yahweh loves the upright,but he frustrates the wicked.
146.10: Yahweh reigns for ever, your God, Zion, from age to age.

147.1: Alleluia! Praise Yahweh -- it is good to sing psalms to our God -- how pleasant to praise him.
147.2: Yahweh, Builder of Jerusalem! He gathers together the exiles of Israel,
147.3: healing the broken-hearted and binding up their wounds;
147.4: he counts out the number of the stars, and gives each one of them a name.
147.5: Our Lord is great, all-powerful, his wisdom beyond all telling.
147.6: Yahweh sustains the poor, and humbles the wicked to the ground.
147.7: Sing to Yahweh in thanksgiving, play the harp for our God.
147.8: He veils the sky with clouds, and provides the earth with rain, makes grass grow on the hills and plants for people to use,
147.9: gives fodder to cattle and to young ravens when they cry.
147.10: He takes no delight in the power of horses, no pleasure in human sturdiness;
147.11: his pleasure is in those who fear him, in those who hope in his faithful love.
147.12: Praise Yahweh, Jerusalem, Zion, praise your God.
147.13: For he gives strength to the bars of your gates, he blesses your children within you,
147.14: he maintains the peace of your frontiers, gives you your fill of finest wheat.
147.15: He sends his word to the earth, his command runs quickly,
147.16: he spreads the snow like flax, strews hoarfrost like ashes,
147.17: he sends ice-crystals like breadcrumbs, and who can withstand that cold?
147.18: When he sends his word it thaws them, when he makes his wind blow, the waters are unstopped.
147.19: He reveals his word to Jacob, his statutes and judgements to Israel.
147.20: For no other nation has he done this, no other has known his judgements.

148.1: Alleluia! Praise Yahweh from the heavens, praise him in the heights.
148.2: Praise him, all his angels, praise him, all his host!
148.3: Praise him, sun and moon, praise him, all shining stars,
148.4: praise him, highest heavens, praise him, waters above the heavens.
148.5: Let them praise the name of Yahweh at whose command they were made;
148.6: he established them for ever and ever by an unchanging decree.
148.7: Praise Yahweh from the earth, sea-monsters and all the depths,
148.8: fire and hail, snow and mist, storm-winds that obey his word,
148.9: mountains and every hill, orchards and every cedar,
148.10: wild animals and all cattle, reptiles and winged birds,
148.11: kings of the earth and all nations, princes and all judges on earth,
148.12: young men and girls, old people and children together.
148.13: Let them praise the name of Yahweh, for his name alone is sublime, his splendour transcends earth and heaven.
148.14: For he heightens the strength of his people, to the praise of all his faithful, the children of Israel, the people close to him.

149.1: Alleluia! Sing a new song to Yahweh: his praise in the assembly of the faithful!
149.2: Israel shall rejoice in its Maker, the children of Zion delight in their king;
149.3: they shall dance in praise of his name, play to him on tambourines and harp!
149.4: For Yahweh loves his people, he will crown the humble with salvation.
149.5: The faithful exult in glory, shout for joy as they worship him,
149.6: praising God to the heights with their voices, a two-edged sword in their hands,
149.7: to wreak vengeance on the nations, punishment on the peoples,
149.8: to load their kings with chains and their nobles with iron fetters,
149.9: to execute on them the judgement passed -- to the honour of all his faithful.

150.1: Alleluia! Praise God in his holy place, praise him in the heavenly vault of his power,
150.2: praise him for his mighty deeds, praise him for all his greatness.
150.3: Praise him with fanfare of trumpet, praise him with harp and lyre,
150.4: praise him with tambourines and dancing, praise him with strings and pipes,
150.5: praise him with the clamour of cymbals, praise him with triumphant cymbals,
150.6: Let everything that breathes praise Yahweh. Alleluia!

1.1: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel:
1.2: for learning what wisdom and discipline are, for understanding words of deep meaning,
1.3: for acquiring a disciplined insight, uprightness, justice and fair dealing;
1.4: for teaching sound judgement to the simple, and knowledge and reflection to the young;
1.5: Let the wise listen and learn yet more, and a person of discernment will acquire the art of guidance.
1.6: for perceiving the meaning of proverbs and obscure sayings, the sayings of the sages and their riddles.
1.7: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; fools spurn wisdom and discipline.
1.8: Listen, my child, to your father's instruction, do not reject your mother's teaching:
1.9: they will be a crown of grace for your head, a circlet for your neck.
1.10: My child, if sinners try to seduce you, do not go with them.
1.11: If they say, 'Come with us: let us lie in ambush to shed blood; if we plan an ambush for the innocent without provocation,
1.12: we can swallow them alive, like Sheol, and whole, like those who sink into oblivion.
1.13: We shall find treasures of every sort, we shall fill our houses with plunder;
1.14: throw in your lot with us: one purse between us all.'
1.15: My child, do not follow them in their way, keep your steps out of their path
1.16: for their feet hasten to evil, they are quick to shed blood;
1.17: for the net is spread in vain if any winged creature can see it.
1.18: It is for their own blood such people lie in wait, their ambush is against their own selves!
1.19: Such are the paths of all who seek dishonest gain: which robs of their lives all who take it for their own.
1.20: Wisdom calls aloud in the streets, she raises her voice in the public squares;
1.21: she calls out at the street corners, she delivers her message at the city gates.
1.22: 'You simple people, how much longer will you cling to your simple ways? How much longer will mockers revel in their mocking and fools go on hating knowledge?
1.23: Pay attention to my warning. To you I will pour out my heart and tell you what I have to say.
1.24: Since I have called and you have refused me, since I have beckoned and no one has taken notice,
1.25: since you have ignored all my advice and rejected all my warnings,
1.26: I, for my part, shall laugh at your distress, I shall jeer when terror befalls you,
1.27: when terror befalls you, like a storm, when your distress arrives, like a whirlwind, when ordeal and anguish bear down on you.
1.28: Then they will call me, but I shall not answer, they will look eagerly for me and will not find me.
1.29: They have hated knowledge, they have not chosen the fear of Yahweh,
1.30: they have taken no notice of my advice, they have spurned all my warnings:
1.31: so they will have to eat the fruits of their own ways of life, and choke themselves with their own scheming.
1.32: For the errors of the simple lead to their death, the complacency of fools works their own ruin;
1.33: but whoever listens to me may live secure, will have quiet, fearing no mischance.'

2.1: My child, if you take my words to heart, if you set store by my commandments,
2.2: tuning your ear to wisdom, tuning your heart to understanding,
2.3: yes, if your plea is for clear perception, if you cry out for understanding,
2.4: if you look for it as though for silver, search for it as though for buried treasure,
2.5: then you will understand what the fear of Yahweh is, and discover the knowledge of God.
2.6: For Yahweh himself is giver of wisdom, from his mouth issue knowledge and understanding.
2.7: He reserves his advice for the honest, a shield to those whose ways are sound;
2.8: he stands guard over the paths of equity, he keeps watch over the way of those faithful to him.
2.9: Then you will understand uprightness, equity and fair dealing, the paths that lead to happiness.
2.10: When wisdom comes into your heart and knowledge fills your soul with delight,
2.11: then prudence will be there to watch over you, and understanding will be your guardian
2.12: to keep you from the way that is evil, from those whose speech is deceitful,
2.13: from those who leave the paths of honesty to walk the roads of darkness:
2.14: those who find their joy in doing wrong, and their delight in deceitfulness,
2.15: whose tracks are twisted, and the paths that they tread crooked.
2.16: To keep you, too, from the woman who belongs to another, from the stranger, with her wheedling words;
2.17: she has left the partner of her younger days, she has forgotten the covenant of her God;
2.18: her house is tilting towards Death, down to the Shades go her paths.
2.19: Of those who go to her not one returns, they never regain the paths of life.
2.20: Thus you will tread the way of good people, persisting in the paths of the upright.
2.21: For the land will be for the honest to live in, the innocent will have it for their home;
2.22: while the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the faithless rooted out of it.

3.1: My child, do not forget my teaching, let your heart keep my principles,
3.2: since they will increase your length of days, your years of life and your well-being.
3.3: Let faithful love and constancy never leave you: tie them round your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.
3.4: Thus you will find favour and success in the sight of God and of people.
3.5: Trust wholeheartedly in Yahweh, put no faith in your own perception;
3.6: acknowledge him in every course you take, and he will see that your paths are smooth.
3.7: Do not congratulate yourself on your own wisdom, fear Yahweh and turn your back on evil:
3.8: health-giving, this, to your body, relief to your bones.
3.9: Honour Yahweh with what goods you have and with the first-fruits of all your produce;
3.10: then your barns will be filled with corn, your vats overflowing with new wine.
3.11: My child, do not scorn correction from Yahweh, do not resent his reproof;
3.12: for Yahweh reproves those he loves, as a father the child whom he loves.
3.13: Blessed are those who have discovered wisdom, those who have acquired understanding!
3.14: Gaining her is more rewarding than silver, her yield is more valuable than gold.
3.15: She is beyond the price of pearls, nothing you could covet is her equal.
3.16: In her right hand is length of days; in her left hand, riches and honour.
3.17: Her ways are filled with delight, her paths all lead to contentment.
